headline: Linn of Mercy Sees Fierce Clashes Amid Broad Central Attrition
war_summary: Since the last edition, the heaviest fighting has converged squarely upon the Linn of Mercy, where fierce back-and-forth assaults over Outwich Ranch, Lathair, and Ulster Falls generated five base transitions and over four thousand casualties in the past two hours. Mooring County has suddenly re-ignited with fresh base turnovers after a brief lull, whereas the rapid shifts previously reported in the Palantine Berm have subsided into an attritional pause. Meanwhile, severe attrition continues unabated in the Weathered Expanse, where Colonial and Warden forces traded upwards of thirty-five hundred casualties in two hours without fresh line changes. On the flanks, combat along the Nevish Line and Marban Hollow has moderated from its earlier peak intensity, with casualty rates cooling and frontline strongpoints holding steady. Rear regions across the deep north and south remain virtually quiet, leaving the war's active momentum centered on the contested heartland.
